title: Art of play in the age of AI
author: Cassidy Williams
description: Now that code ships faster than ever, you have more time to spend on projects just for the fun of it. Here's what we can learn through that process as developers. The post Art of play in the age of AI appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: As kids, we spent hours tinkering and building and just messing with things. As an adult, I could watch my own young kiddos figure out how certain shapes and movement work all day.
takeaways: At the GitHub Universe closing keynote, Martin wanted to teach himself machine learning, so he built himself a pedometer onto his conference badge.
He used Copilot to collect movement data from the badge’s accelerometer, trained a simple machine-learning model in his browser, and deployed it to the badge.
With that kind of pace of change, it’s easy to feel unsteady thinking about our coding skills that we’ve been honing as an industry for decades.
